title: Fresh wheel build and core import smoke
agent_persona: A bioinformatics developer installing rustscenic from a clean Linux environment before trying a dataset.
goal: Build a wheel from the archived checkout, install the core dependency set, verify version metadata, import every public compute stage, and prove the CLI responds.

commands.name: Install built wheel through the package metadata path
commands.run:
WHL=$(ls target/wheels/rustscenic-*.whl | head -1)
python -m pip install "$WHL"

commands.name: Verify imports, version, bundled TF lists, and CLI help
commands.run:
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata
import re
import rustscenic
import rustscenic.aucell
import rustscenic.cistarget
import rustscenic.data
import rustscenic.enhancer
import rustscenic.eregulon
import rustscenic.grn
import rustscenic.pipeline
import rustscenic.preproc
import rustscenic.topics

with open('pyproject.toml', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    expected = re.search(r'^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', fh.read(), re.MULTILINE).group(1)
installed = importlib.metadata.version('rustscenic')
assert installed == expected, f'version mismatch: installed={installed} expected={expected}'
assert len(rustscenic.data.tfs('human')) > 1000
assert len(rustscenic.data.tfs('mouse')) > 1000
print(f'rustscenic {installed} core imports OK')
PY
rustscenic --help | head -40
